entry.description: `%aspnet-context`, `%aspnet-request` and `%aspnet-session` show `NOT AVAILABLE` instead of another request's values for an event buffered with its properties fixed and flushed by a later request, and for one built from `LoggingEventData` or deserialized. Property dumps then list an empty `log4net:AspNetRequest`. A buffer whose `fix` leaves out `Properties`, or an event first fixed off the logging thread, still shows the request that renders it (ANT-2026-O0DMJJ34, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
